scope: Local RADAR research. Reserve the listed windows from future fitting/tuning/feature selection until the first predeclared historical evaluation is completed. This does not certify independent flood events or prospective accuracy.

windows.purpose: Entire May2021, including documented lateMay event; prior report peak/date information is already known.
Entire MayJune2022, including reported events; does not silently repair conflicting document dates.

prior_exposure: SGB documentary reports and peak/date descriptions are being inspected for source discovery. No2021May/2022MayJune date references were found in the current scripts/docs search before this reservation; no model inference on these windows is performed in this turn. This scoped check is not a proof that no historical model anywhere ever used the years.
collection_rules: Preserve original timestamps/QC and immutable raw responses withURL/retrieval/hash. Collection and input/target coverage audit are allowed before evaluation; do not calculate model errors or select candidate parameters using these windows. Missing series or offgrid timestamps must be reported, never rounded, interpolated or converted to zero to meet eligibility.
candidate_freeze: Before first inference, register one candidate family and frozen training membership, parameters, feature/source contract and control version independently of these windows. Freeze model/input hashes. Evaluate all1..12 horizons, all scheduled rows and observed>=7m subset, including failures; no selection of favorable events/horizons.
uncertainty: If raw sources do not support the declared exact timestamp contract, report unavailable coverage rather than redefining the evaluation after seeing model errors. Datum/timezone/publication/regime andevent independence require separate checks. Historical comparison never replaces1000prospective forecasts perhorizon and10certified independent floods.
after_first_evaluation: If results are used to modify the model, these windows become development data. A later comparison on them must not be presented as a fresh independent test.
